title: Distinguished Mayer–Vietoris triangle from extension by zero
statement:
Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], let $X=U\cup V$ with $U,V\subseteq X$ open, and let $D(\mathcal O_X)$ be the derived category of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, let $j_U:U\hookrightarrow X$, $j_V:V\hookrightarrow X$, and $j_{UV}:U\cap V\hookrightarrow X$ be the open inclusions, and write $j_!$ for the exact extension-by-zero functor [lem-sc-derived-open-restriction-adjunction-exact], applied termwise to complexes to act on derived categories [lem-sc-derived-open-shriek-derived-adjunction]. Then there is a distinguished triangle
$$
 j_{UV,!}(E|_{U\cap V}) \longrightarrow j_{U,!}(E|_U)\oplus j_{V,!}(E|_V) \longrightarrow E \longrightarrow j_{UV,!}(E|_{U\cap V})[1].
$$
The first map is the difference of the two extension-by-zero restriction maps, the second map is the pair of counits, and the third map is the boundary morphism $\delta$ that [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-triangle] attaches to the degreewise short exact sequence of complexes $0\to j_{UV,!}(K^\bullet|_{U\cap V})\to j_{U,!}(K^\bullet|_U)\oplus j_{V,!}(K^\bullet|_V)\to K^\bullet\to0$, for any complex $K^\bullet$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules representing $E$.

source.place: Tag 08BU (cohomology-lemma-exact-sequence-lower-shriek), distinguished triangle for a two-open cover

proof.text: Choose a representative complex K^bullet for E. Applying the short exact Mayer–Vietoris sequence for extension by zero [lem-sc-derived-open-mayer-vietoris-ses] to each term K^n gives a degreewise short exact sequence of complexes 0 \to j_{UV,!}(K^bullet restricted to U intersection V) \to j_{U,!}(K^bullet restricted to U) direct-sum j_{V,!}(K^bullet restricted to V) \to K^bullet \to 0. Exactness of each j_! is the hypothesis supplied by [lem-sc-derived-open-restriction-adjunction-exact].

source.place: Tag 08BU proof, exact sequence of complexes obtained termwise from the lower-shriek short exact sequence

proof.text: Apply the generic theorem that a degreewise short exact sequence of complexes in an abelian category gives a distinguished triangle whose third map is its boundary morphism delta [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-triangle]. The resulting triangle in D(O_X) is j_{UV,!}(E restricted to U intersection V) \to j_{U,!}(E restricted to U) direct-sum j_{V,!}(E restricted to V) \to E \to j_{UV,!}(E restricted to U intersection V)[1], with third map the boundary morphism delta of the sequence of Step 1, as stated.

source.place: Tag 08BU, distinguished triangle associated to the lower-shriek short exact sequence

proof.text: The first map is the difference map and the second map is the pair of counits by the defining maps in the short exact sequence [lem-sc-derived-open-mayer-vietoris-ses]. The exact extension-by-zero and restriction functors induce the corresponding derived functors computed termwise, so the displayed terms are the stated derived functors of the restrictions of E [lem-sc-derived-open-shriek-derived-adjunction].
